title: Fused sparse addressing, structural admission, predictive transition routing, and verified operator consolidation
question: Can the validated product-key addressing frontier and the PST-StructMeans-AXON-REGM-SECA loop be composed so that final decision work is fixed as M grows while preserving held-out operator capability?
closed_loop: SECA result -> independent verification -> operator memory
rules: No C5 or sublinear claim from a bounded final shortlist alone.
Product-key internal exact address scoring remains part of measured routing cost.
StructMeans and PST are fit only from verified training experience; held-out operator signatures are excluded from bootstrap/codebook training.
SECA is evaluated after base retrieval and is not used to rescue single-step routing metrics.
Post-execution verifier information never enters route().
